notes: Read repository AGENTS.md, research/CONTRACT.md and all four health-systems role files. Inspected the merged implications for all 14 distinct records (10 discovery, four diamond). Only this review file is changed.

Independent live source coverage: directly read the four Sage title-specific author pages; Emerald title homepages/about pages, their linked fee/author policy and publication-ethics/preprint policies; Springer scope/instructions/options/homepages; WHO contributor policy; Malaysian Q Bulletin and Journal of Health Management fee/submissions/peer-review policies; and both Elsevier official shop scopes. Retried both ScienceDirect author guides: 403. PAHO About and author instructions returned web-tool 403 but ordinary direct HTTPS 200 and were read in full. Fee absence and peer-review policy remain unresolved for the two Elsevier records.

All 10 verified_free routes were checked against explicit submission-and-publication or blanket no-author-fee policy language. Retained six subscription routes (four Sage, two Emerald) and four diamond routes as verified_free. Four other subscription candidates remain needs_verification: Health Care Management Science, Journal of Medical Systems, International Journal of Medical Informatics and Health Policy. No-APC subscription statements do not prove that every compulsory author cost is absent. Optional OA and requested print color remain separate costs.

Six contribution-only high difficulty judgments were replaced by unknown. Specific novelty, evaluation, rigor and fit conditions remain documented, but the inspected material provides no defensible comparative scale or defined decision cohort for these six. All 14 now have unknown difficulty. Unknown does not mean easy, weak, low prestige or low quality; neither citation impact nor review speed establishes acceptance probability.

Independently matched all nine retained numerical citation displays and their 2025 labels on the two current Emerald and two Springer homepages, including the Health Care Management Science CiteScore update. These are publisher-reported citation metrics with conventional windows, not recomputed values; raw counts were not disclosed. No citation field was changed. Emerald current acceptance snapshots remain omitted because reporting period/population are not defined and older official displays differ. Existing WHO impact-period uncertainty and empty Elsevier metrics remain preserved.

Sage policy permits assistive editing without declaration but requires substantive generative-use disclosure and verification; its prohibited-use examples include prompt-generated data/submissions, simulated qualitative interviews and experience/theme analysis. Source: https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy . Independent researchers are welcomed with possible additional documentation: https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/policy-on-submissions-from-independent-researchers . These sources guide the four Sage scope patches; HIMJ journal-specific preprint permission was not established.

Emerald author guidelines explicitly apply the linked ethics policy to all its journals. The policy prohibits GenAI copywriting and research-data/results generation/reporting, permits copyediting, and gives narrower use-case examples. Its prose permits disclosed analysis aids while the table disallows results analysis; this tension is not resolved into blanket permission. Source: https://www.emerald.com/publish-with-us/pages/publication-ethics . Both affected journals retain free eligibility but require a compliant human-directed manuscript workflow. Preprint source: https://www.emerald.com/publish-with-us/pages/pre-prints-conference-papers .

Q Bulletin remains limited to completed QA/QI within five years and at least two cycles; Malaysian Journal of Health Management remains distinct from the Sage title. WHO study-country affiliation/preprint restrictions and any-AI disclosure remain explicit. PAHO preprint disclosure is not automatic approval. No unverified general AI permission was inferred for the Malaysian or Elsevier journals.

This is bounded independent agent review, not human scientific, editorial or usability approval, manuscript-specific matching, an exhaustive search of every policy report, or a guarantee of acceptance. No venue contact, submission, remote write, merge, deployment or publication was performed.
